name: Baby, BE -Bedside Emotion-
source:
Our hero sees a "help wanted" sign at a restaurant in Chinatown in Yokohama. He applies for the job and meets the owners. Two beautiful sisters run the restaurant, and they decide to hire him because he really has a desire to work. He begins to live in their house and help in the restaurant. These young people really start to get involved with each other as they interact on a daily basis.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030214184023/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ha/baby_be/]gamelexgs[/url]]
translation:
主角在橫濱中華街的一家餐廳看到「誠徵店員」的告示，於是上門應徵，並見到了老闆。經營這家餐廳的是一對美麗姊妹，她們看出他確實很想工作，便決定錄用他。從此，他住進姊妹二人的家中，並在餐廳裡幫忙。這群年輕人在朝夕相處中，彼此之間的關係也逐漸變得更加親近。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030214184023/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ha/baby_be/]gamelexgs[/url]]
